name: Asahina Kohina
source:
"I-I'll do my best…!"

Big breasts, tiny voice. A sweet, innoncent, kind-hearted girl with extreme social anxiety.

She's thoughtful and gentle, but can't speak up for herself

and stays silent unless spoken to.

Earnestly wants to change and follows the protagonist's advice with heartfelt dedication.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3862740/Love_Advisor_Youre_a_mess_and_I_adore_you/]Steam[/url]]
